body.statement: For distinct current vertices \(u,v\in V_\ell\) with nonempty parent sets whose pair-query measured endpoints belong to \(\mathcal Q_{\mathrm{stab}}(P_X)\), \(\rho_\ell(\{u,v\},V_\ell\setminus\{u,v\})\le1\) if and only if \(\operatorname{Pa}_G(u)=\operatorname{Pa}_G(v)=\{h\}\) for some \(h\in V_{\ell+1}\). Consequently, on a complete run the nontrivial connected components of \(\sim_\ell\) are exactly the pure blocks \(B_h\).
body.justification: A pairwise criterion replaces the anchor's all-subsets pure-child search.
body.gap: Prashant et al.'s pure-child lemma quantifies over all subsets and does not provide this pairwise equivalence or its recursive observed-surrogate form.
body.consumer: Every latent parent and its full pure-child block becomes recoverable with at most one query per current pair.
